title: Rotorua Geothermal Parks Guide — Te Puia vs Wai-O-Tapu vs Hell's Gate
meta_desc: Rotorua geothermal parks guide for families: compare Te Puia, Wai-O-Tapu, and Hell's Gate
intro: Rotorua is home to some of New Zealand's most unique and breathtaking geothermal parks. With so many options to choose from, it can be difficult to decide which one to visit, especially when traveling with kids. In this guide, we'll compare Te Puia, Wai-O-Tapu, and Hell's Gate to help you make an informed decision.

sections.heading: Overview of Rotorua Geothermal Parks
sections.body: Rotorua is a 3-hour drive from Auckland and is home to several world-class geothermal parks. Each park offers a unique experience, with Te Puia focusing on Maori culture and geothermal wonders, Wai-O-Tapu showcasing colorful hot springs and geysers, and Hell's Gate featuring mud pools and a spa.

rows: Colorful hot springs, geysers, Lady Knox Geyser
Mud pools, Sulphur Spa, geothermal walk

sections.heading: Best for Families
sections.body: All three parks are suitable for families, but Te Puia and Wai-O-Tapu are particularly popular with kids. Te Puia offers a guided tour and a chance to see kiwi birds, while Wai-O-Tapu features a interactive exhibit and a geyser that erupts daily at 10:15 am.
list: Te Puia: guided tour, kiwi birds, and Maori cultural performances
Wai-O-Tapu: interactive exhibit, Lady Knox Geyser, and colorful hot springs

sections.heading: Getting There and Around
sections.body: The drive time between Rotorua city and the geothermal parks is approximately 10-20 minutes. You can also use public transportation or book a guided tour that includes transportation. If you're planning to visit multiple parks, consider renting a campervan or car to make the most of your trip.

sections.heading: Accommodation Options
sections.body: Rotorua offers a range of accommodation options, from budget-friendly hotels to luxury resorts. Consider staying in the city center to be close to amenities and activities. You can also book a campsite or holiday park for a more affordable and family-friendly option.
list: City center hotels: Millennium Hotel, Novotel Rotorua Lakeside
Luxury resorts: Polynesian Spa Resort, Black Swan Lakeside Boutique Hotel
Campgrounds and holiday parks: Rotorua Top 10 Holiday Resort, All Seasons Holiday Park
